session_summary: A patient visited the doctor with symptoms of cough, fever, and fatigue. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended a chest X-ray, and issued a medical leave. Additional tests were scheduled, and the patient was advised to quit smoking.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Chest X-ray
proposed_actions.description: Patient needs to schedule a chest X-ray at the county hospital.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want a chest X-ray today or at the latest tomorrow.

proposed_actions.title: Get Medical Leave Certificate
proposed_actions.description: Patient needs to collect the medical leave certificate from the doctor.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll issue the medical leave certificate now, you take it to human resources.

proposed_actions.title: Perform Complete Blood Count and C-Reactive Protein Test
proposed_actions.description: Patient needs to undergo blood tests on an empty stomach tomorrow morning.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Do a complete blood count and C-reactive protein, tomorrow morning, on an empty stomach.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Follow-up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Patient needs to return on Tuesday, November tenth, at half past ten, with the X-ray and tests.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: When should I come back? I'll be waiting on Tuesday, November tenth, at half past ten, with the X-ray and the tests.

proposed_actions.title: Enroll in Smoking Cessation Program
proposed_actions.description: Patient needs to be enrolled in the smoking cessation program at the clinic.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I recommend the smoking cessation program at the clinic. I'll put you on the list and the assistant, Mrs. Elena, will call you next week.

decisions: Doctor prescribed amoxicillin with clavulanic acid for seven days.
Patient was given a medical leave of absence for five days, up to Tuesday inclusive.
Patient was advised to take paracetamol for fever.
risks: Patient may experience difficulty breathing or fever above thirty-nine, requiring immediate attention.
Patient may not follow through with the smoking cessation program.
follow_up_questions: Will the assistant, Mrs. Elena, be available to call the patient next week?
Is there a specific time the patient needs to return for the follow-up appointment?
